Hi Tom —

Thanks, and great speaking last week. Attached is our completed questionnaire (spreadsheet) and three supporting artifacts: a redacted SOC2 Type II, an admin console screenshot showing the Roles page and an example audit view, plus a small SCIM mapping sample you can use to validate group-sync expectations.

High-level notes:
- SSO: We support both SAML 2.0 and OIDC; customers can require IdP-initiated or SP-initiated flows. Metadata exchange and cert rollover are supported.
- SCIM: Full user and group provisioning (SCIM 2.0). We support group-to-team mapping and attribute filters; write operations are authenticated with per-tenant service credentials.
- RBAC / Delegation: Role hierarchy with Admin, Operator, and Viewer roles; we also support scoped operator roles limited to a project or model namespace. Delegated admin scopes are configurable at org or project level.
- Audit & retention: Audit events available via console and API. Default retention is 90 days in hosted; enterprise customers can request extended retention or log exports.

If you want, we can provide a short (15–20 min) walk-through of the admin pages. Otherwise, let us know specific clarifications and we will respond.

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding Finli's clarifying questions (below). Proposed answers are inline — please review and flag anything that needs legal or infra confirmation before I reply to them. We need to get back within EOD tomorrow to keep their security committee timeline.

Proposed answers: 
1) Delegated admin: Yes — Operator roles are namespace-scoped. Operators only see projects/teams they are granted; admin console enforces RBAC at the API layer, preventing cross-project access. Audit logs are tagged with project_id and access is filtered. (Action: Ben, confirm that audit views are filter-enforced at the API layer and cannot be bypassed.)

2) SCIM mapping: By default SCIM group.members map to Redwood team membership. Customers can map multiple IdP groups to a single Redwood team via the mapping table in our admin UI. See attached scim-mapping-sample.csv. (Action: Marissa, confirm we can provide a small sample mapping file in CSV format.)

3) Audit retention: Default 90 days. For enterprise customers we offer extended retention packages (12/24 months) as an add-on; logs can be exported to customer-owned S3 and we provide a streaming SIEM connector (typical SLA: export config applied within 5 business days of contract signature). (Action: Ben / Marissa, please confirm export-enabled retention options and approximate timeline.)

Attachments included for Finli response: SOC2 redacted PDF, admin console screenshot, scim sample.

Thanks,
Steph
